<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Let me systematically test all 4 rotations with purple stamps
# First reset to all white by stamping with white on all 4 rotations

# Rotate to rectangle (0°) and stamp white
action(['LEFT', 'LEFT'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels'] > 80 and n['pixels'] < 90:

# Stamp white

for i in range(34, 44):
    line = ascii_lines[i][27:37]
    print(f"Row {i:2d}: {line}")
wc = sum(1 for i in range(34, 44) for j in range(27, 37) if ascii_lines[i][j] == 'W')
pc = sum(1 for i in range(34, 44) for j in range(27, 37) if ascii_lines[i][j] == 'p')
print(f"White: {wc}, Purple: {pc}")
</parameter>
</function>
